question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e. **'Gathered'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence describes** a situation where Arizona State University students came together for a specific purpose, which was to assemble portable air purifiers.
 
• Among the given options, **"gathered" **is the most appropriate word, as it means to come together in a group to achieve a common goal.
 
• In this context, the students** "gathered"** to work on a project, making the term the logical choice to fill the blank.
 
• **Other options** like "plated," "triggered," or "dismissed" don't fit the meaning of the sentence, as they convey completely different actions.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'One afternoon, a dozen Arizona State University students **gathered **to spend the morning cutting cardboard, taping fans and assembling filters in an effort to (2)_____ 125 portable air purifiers for local schools. That (3)_______ morning, staff members at a homeless shelter in Los Angeles were setting (4)_______ 20 homemade purifiers of their own, while in Brookline, Massachusetts, another DIY air purifier was whirring quietly in the back of a day care (5)______ as children played.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plated** (परत चढ़ाना) - Refers to coating something with a thin layer, usually metal; not suitable here.
 
• **Triggered **(प्रेरित) - Means to cause or initiate something; does not fit the context.
 
• **Dismissed** (खारिज) - Refers to sending someone away or rejecting something; irrelevant in this context.
